about: What the estimator concluded for each Learn job (docs/superpowers/plans/step-3-facts.md). bid null = report the result, don't check it. sheet_numbers_at_least / typed_at_least = share of drawing sheets whose sheet number must be found / that must be sorted by type. others_include (optional) = other controls manufacturers the bid check must name for the US team. overview_makers_include (optional) = manufacturers the Spec overview tab must name, confirmed by hand in the quote. unreadable_at_most = the most pages that may come back unreadable, set from a recorded run — a rise is a regression worth a look.

26-0334.note: Its one drawing set is a scanned/photographed PDF; several title blocks are too faint for OCR to read, so fewer sheets can be sorted by type. Checked by hand.

26-0436.note: Its own project manual has no controls section — the controls spec lives in the nested 26-0437 folder, catalogued as its own job. Checked by hand. Read as Open: the controls appendix (Marked_NY10-1 IFP - 13 CONTROLS - Appendix.pdf) calls for Allen-Bradley PLCs and owner-furnished DDC, and none of the lines AME bids is named — the US team decides, not a Schneider medium-voltage switchgear note elsewhere in the set.
